recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed unless a later work-group decision changes the warning severity or the modular-questionnaire exception behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-43704 was an Applied FHIR-core Questionnaire change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for a constraint enforcing that Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.question refer to a valid linkId in the Questionnaire. The approved modification was to add the invariant as a warning because draft questionnaires and modular questionnaires can legitimately reference questions defined elsewhere.
initial_application: The issue was applied on master by git commit 10c6afadf8c6a06680cb833b5495a319a190782c, which added warning invariant que-18 to Questionnaire.item.enableWhen and marked Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.question with condition que-18. That implementation is still present in current source.
additional_context: Questionnaire is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, placing source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml in current build scope. Confluence SDC minutes for 2024-02-22 record the FHIR-43704 persuasive-with-modification motion. Searches found older published Questionnaire enableWhen/linkId issues but no later or community evidence reversing this warning constraint, and no Zulip message mentioning FHIR-43704.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Questionnaire StructureDefinition already contains the warning invariant requested by FHIR-43704.
